newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SAS denies report of Lufthansa merger plan.
newsitem.headline: SAS denies report of Lufthansa merger plan.

text.p: Scandinavian Airlines said on Monday it has no plans to merge with its German cooperation partner Lufthansa, dismissing a Danish newspaper report.
"We have a strategic alliance with Lufthansa," Knut Lovstuhagen, head of information, told Reuters.
"The alliance is set up between two independent companies. There are no plans for a merger."
Lovstuhagen dismissed an article in Danish newspaper Borsen which said the cooperation was more and more taking the form of a real merger.
According to the newspaper, Lufthansa's vice president Stefan Lauer hinted that the alliance will end in a merger shortly.
Lauer also mentioned that Lufthansa, along with its alliance partners, are facing giant investments, for example in new check-in systems.
Lovstuhagen said there were talks in certain areas.
"We can reach synergies in several areas," Lovstuhagen said. "The intention is, for example, that all IT systems will be common.
Lovstuhagen did not, however, directly comment on future investments.
